properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 20 at 12:51PM PDT until October 22 at 11:00AM PDT by NWS Hanford CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...There is an 80% chance of 4 inches or more of snow along the
Tioga Pass and highway 120. There is a 50-60% chance for four
inches or more of snow above 8,000 feet in Tulare, Madera, and
Fresno counties.

* WHERE...Above 8,000 feet in the Sierra Nevada.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Wednesday to 11 AM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Roads, and especially bridges and overpasses, will likely
become slick and hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snowfall will affect traffic across Tioga
Highway/Pass.
properties.instruction:
Be prepared for slippery roads. Slow down and use caution while
driving. If you are going outside, watch your first few steps taken
on stairs, sidewalks, and driveways. These surfaces could be icy and
slippery, increasing your risk of a fall and injury.

NWSheadline: WINTER WEATHER ADVISORY IN EFFECT ABOVE 8,000 FEET FROM 11 AM WEDNESDAY TO 11 AM PDT THURSDAY
